# Sunday Rolls Golf

> Premium, vintage-inspired embroidered putter covers for L.A.B. DF3, L.A.B. Oz.1 and Mezz.1, and TaylorMade Spider putters, plus waffle-knit golf towels. Designed in the USA; based in Minneapolis, MN.

Putter covers are $80 and close with a magnet over a soft velvet lining. Each cover is made for a specific putter shape, so match the cover to your putter: center-shafted (L.A.B. DF3/DF3i), heel-shafted mallet (TaylorMade Spider), or L.A.B. Oz.1/Mezz.1 (center-shaft models only). Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery.

## Putter covers by fit
- [L.A.B. DF3 Putter Covers](https://sunday-rolls.github.io/website/putter-covers/lab-df3/): Embroidered covers cut for the DF3's center shaft, with a magnetic closure and a soft velvet lining.
- [TaylorMade Spider & Mallet Putter Covers](https://sunday-rolls.github.io/website/putter-covers/spider-mallet/): Embroidered covers shaped for heel-shafted mallets like the TaylorMade Spider.
- [L.A.B. Oz.1 & Mezz.1 Putter Covers](https://sunday-rolls.github.io/website/putter-covers/lab-oz-mezz/): Embroidered covers contoured for L.A.B.'s Oz.1 and Mezz.1 center-shaft putters.
